title: Text 2
subtitle: 莫纳克亚望远镜之争：天文学与夏威夷文化

sentences.en: "The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers," wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii's last reigning monarch, in 1897.
sentences.zh: 夏威夷最后一位在位的君主利留卡拉尼女王在1897年写道：“古代夏威夷人就是天文学家。”

sentences.en: Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society.
sentences.zh: 观星者是夏威夷社会最受尊敬的成员之一。

sentences.en: Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，如今夏威夷的天文学发展并不顺利。

sentences.en: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
sentences.zh: 围绕三十米望远镜（TMT）的建造爆发了抗议活动，这座巨型天文台有望彻底改变人类对宇宙的认识。

sentences.en: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
sentences.zh: 争议的焦点在于TMT计划建于莫纳克亚山——一座被一些夏威夷人奉为“脐带”（piko）、连接夏威夷群岛与上天的休眠火山。

sentences.en: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.
sentences.zh: 但莫纳克亚山也是世界上一些最强大的望远镜的所在地。

sentences.en: Rested in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
sentences.zh: 莫纳克亚山矗立于太平洋之中，其山峰高耸于地球稠密大气层的主体之上，那里的条件使望远镜能够获得清晰度无与伦比的图像。

sentences.en: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.
sentences.zh: 反对在莫纳克亚山上建造望远镜并非新鲜事。

sentences.en: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，一小部分但声音很大的夏威夷人和环保主义者将这些望远镜的存在视为对圣地的亵渎，也视为对曾经是主权国家之地被占领的痛苦提醒。

sentences.en: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
sentences.zh: 当前这场争议的部分责任在于天文学家。

sentences.en: In their eagerness to build bigger telescopes, they forgot that science is not the only way of understanding the world.
sentences.zh: 他们急于建造更大的望远镜，却忘了科学并非理解世界的唯一方式。

sentences.en: They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea's fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the islands' inhabitants.
sentences.zh: 他们并不总是把保护莫纳克亚山脆弱的生态系统、以及它对岛上居民的神圣性放在首位。

sentences.en: Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today.
sentences.zh: 夏威夷文化不是过去的遗物；它是一种活生生的文化，如今正在经历复兴。

sentences.en: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization.
sentences.zh: 然而，科学也有自己的文化历史，其根源可以追溯到文明的黎明。

sentences.en: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.
sentences.zh: 正是那种探寻地平线之外有何存在的好奇心，最初把早期的波利尼西亚人带到了夏威夷海岸，如今也激励着天文学家去探索苍穹。

sentences.en: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
sentences.zh: 要求拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜、或禁止在那里进行未来开发的主张，忽视了这样一个现实：天文学和夏威夷文化都在寻求回答关于我们是谁、我们从哪里来、要到哪里去这些重大问题。

sentences.en: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是我们探索星空的原因，仿佛是在回应一种原始的召唤，去认识我们自己以及真正的祖先家园。

sentences.en: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea.
sentences.zh: 天文学界正在做出让步，以改变其对莫纳克亚山的使用方式。

sentences.en: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.
sentences.zh: TMT的选址经过了精心选择，以尽量减少望远镜在岛上四周的可见度，并避免对考古和环境造成影响。

sentences.en: To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state.
sentences.zh: 为了限制莫纳克亚山上望远镜的数量，旧望远镜将在使用寿命结束后被拆除，其选址将恢复自然状态。

sentences.en: There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.
sentences.zh: 没有理由不能让所有人都登上莫纳克亚山，去拥抱自己的文化遗产、去研究星辰。

questions.stem: Queen Liliuokalani’s remark in Paragraph 1 indicates ____

options.A: her conservative view on the historical role of astronomy.
options.B: the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society.
options.C: the regrettable decline of astronomy in ancient times.
options.D: her appreciation of star watchers’ feats in her time.

questions.analysis: 本题属于推断题，定位在第一段。The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers, 古代的夏威夷人都是天文学家，Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society，星象观察者在古代备受尊重，所以最佳答案应该是the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society.在古代夏威夷天文学是非常重要的。

questions.stem: Mauna Kea is deemed as an ideal astronomical site due to ____
questions.analysis: 本题属于细节题，定位在第二段。Mauna Kea's peak rises above…, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity. 在Mauna Kea的环境或条件，望远镜能看到非常清晰的太空的情况，所以是由于地理位置才被选为理想的天文观测地。

questions.stem: The construction of the TMT is opposed by some locals partly because ____

options.A: it may risk ruining their intellectual life.
options.B: it reminds them of a humiliating history.
options.C: their culture will lose a chance of revival.
options.D: they fear losing control of Mauna Kea.

questions.analysis: 本题属于细节题，定位在第三段。A small but local group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect far sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation，一小部分本地人反对是认为Mauna Kea是神圣不可侵犯，并且提醒他们曾经痛苦的一段历史，所以与答案B符合，it reminds them of a humiliating history。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that progress in today’s astronomy ____

options.A: is fulfilling the dreams of ancient Hawaiians.
options.B: helps spread Hawaiian culture across the world.
options.C: may uncover the origin of Hawaiian culture.

questions.analysis: 本题属于推断题，定位在第五段。Calls to… Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.通过这部分的论述表明天文学和夏威夷文化寻求回答我们是谁，从哪来，到哪去的这些问题，所以题干问天文学的进步可能会怎样，只有C符合原文含义，揭露夏威夷文化的起源，其他三项中的文章并未提及。

questions.stem: The author’s attitude toward choosing Mauna Kea as the TMT site is one of ____
questions.analysis: 本题属于观点态度题，主要定位在最后一段。作者说There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.欢迎每个人来Mauna Kea来拥抱文化遗产，研究星象。说明是比较支持的态度，但有不是完全支持，作者赞同天文学领域人士做出让步，保护当地的生态环境，所以D是错误的。
